title: Robotic Subsystem Gripper, Titan Rover
description: Designed and built a high-force worm-drive gripper for the Titan Rover to lift 10 lb from the floor. Used a NEMA 11 motor with a 5:1 gearbox and 35:1 worm reduction to achieve ~42 lb of tip force per side, validated with stress analysis and fabricated with SLA-printed Formlabs Rigid 4000 components and a low-friction nylon gear + brass worm pairing.
skills: SLA 3D Printing with Engineering Strength Materials
